title: Design System: SwiftDrop /p2p/
scope: The /p2p/ surface only (apps/web/p2p.html, src/p2p/P2PApp.tsx, src/p2p/p2p.css). The PC app at apps/web/index.html keeps its own lime 'Quiet Signal' world in src/styles.css and is not described here.

display.purpose: Home headline only; second line dimmed to text-4.

speed-numeral.purpose: Live MB/s in the transfer meter; tabular.

headline.purpose: Screen titles and the transfer file name.

section.purpose: Pane headings such as Recent transfers.

body.purpose: Explanatory lines under headlines, max 44ch, text-2.

mono.purpose: Pasted codes and the debug panel only.

shadows.name: glass-edge
shadows.purpose: Border of every glass surface, pill, field and button.

shadows.name: glass-drop
shadows.purpose: Lift under cards, tiles and the viewfinder.

materials.name: glass-blur
materials.purpose: backdrop-filter for cards and tiles; 20px on buttons, 30px saturate(140%) on the desktop window.

materials.name: ground-bloom
materials.value: radial-gradient(48rem 30rem at 50% -10rem, rgb(216 50 42 / 0.2), transparent 70%), radial-gradient(40rem 30rem at 110% 110%, rgb(58 65 80 / 0.35), transparent 70%), #0e0e10

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ef4236, #d8322a); color: #fff; font-family: 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 520; letter-spacing: -0.01em; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.22), 0 12px 28px -12px rgb(216 50 42 / 0.75); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), box-shadow 240ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f34c40, #df372e); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.25), 0 14px 34px -12px rgb(216 50 42 / 0.85); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff8a80; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #1c1c20; color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.36); box-shadow: none; }

components.css: .ds-choices { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 12px; max-width: 380px; } .ds-choice { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 4px; min-height: 156px; padding: 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 24px; text-align: left; color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.94); background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.075), rgb(255 255 255 / 0.04)); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1), inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.075), 0 24px 60px -28px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.85); backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(150%); font-family: 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), box-shadow 240ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-choice:hover { box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1), inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.14), 0 24px 60px -28px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.85); } .ds-choice:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-choice:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff8a80; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-choice[data-tone=red] { background: radial-gradient(120% 90% at 20% 0%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.16), transparent 60%), linear-gradient(160deg, #e5392f, #a91f18); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.25), 0 24px 50px -22px rgb(216 50 42 / 0.9); } .ds-choice[data-tone=red]:hover { box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.3), 0 28px 60px -22px rgb(216 50 42 / 1); } .ds-choice-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 46px; height: 46px; margin-bottom: auto; border-radius: 50%; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.12); } .ds-choice[data-tone=red] .ds-choice-icon { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.2); } .ds-choice-t { margin-top: 16px; font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 620; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-choice-s { min-height: 2.7em; font-size: 0.8rem; line-height: 1.35; color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.7); }

components.css: .ds-meter { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; max-width: 520px; padding: 22px 20px 18px; border-radius: 20px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.075), rgb(255 255 255 / 0.04)); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1), inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.075), 0 24px 60px -28px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.85); backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(150%); color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.94); font-family: 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-feature-settings: 'tnum', 'ss01'; } .ds-meter-top { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; } .ds-speed { font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 2rem + 3vw, 3.6rem); font-weight: 560; letter-spacing: -0.05em; line-height: 1; } .ds-speed small { margin-left: 6px; font-size: 0.36em; font-weight: 520; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.5); } .ds-pct { font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 560; color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.66); } .ds-bar { position: relative; height: 8px; border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08); } .ds-bar span { position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: inherit; transform-origin: left center; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #b9241d, #ef4236); box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgb(239 66 54 / 0.45); transition: transform 220ms linear; } .ds-meter-foot { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; font-size: 0.85rem; color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.5); } .ds-meter-foot span:first-child { color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.66); }

components.name: QR Plate
components.description: Flat near-white plate for the pairing code; never on glass, no centre mark.
components.css: .ds-qr { width: 220px; aspect-ratio: 1; padding: 18px; border-radius: 28px; background: #fafafa; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.4) inset, 0 30px 70px -30px rgb(216 50 42 / 0.55), 0 20px 50px -20px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.8); animation: ds-qr-in 420ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1) both; } @keyframes ds-qr-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.96); filter: blur(6px); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-qr { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The /p2p/ page is the SwiftDrop app running in a browser tab, the same world as the native Flutter app: near-black graphite ground, frosted glass surfaces, and one red. Nothing on screen reads as a web page or a QR utility; it is one app window with a top bar, a single primary pane, and (on desktop) a side pane. Density is phone-first: one column at 480px max, thumb-reach tiles, big honest numbers.

Red carries two meanings only: "act here" and "data is moving". It fills the Send tile, primary buttons, the progress bar, the completion mark and the brand mark; it blooms softly behind the hero device pair. Green is a status colour, not an accent: it appears on the live connection dot and the Verified chip. Everything else is white at stepped opacity on graphite.

Glass is a web approximation of the native material: a faint white vertical gradient, a 1px inset edge plus a top highlight, backdrop blur with saturation, and a long soft drop. Under `prefers-reduced-transparency` every glass surface falls back to a solid graphite fill.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite ground with a red radial bloom at the top and a cool ambient field at the bottom right.
Frosted glass for every container; no visible borders, only inset edges.
One red accent, gradient-lit (lighter top, deeper bottom) on fills.
Pill geometry for every control; 20-28px radii for containers.
Geist with tabular numerals for every live number.
The QR is a flat near-white plate, never on glass, never marked.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Red means "act" or "data moving". It is never decoration, never a second accent hue, and the web red is the native token: change it in colors.dart and here together.

rules.name: The Status Is Not Accent Rule
rules.body: Green and apricot are states. They never fill a button, a tile, or a headline.

rules.name: The Plain Plate Rule
rules.body: The QR sits on flat `qr-paper` with no centre mark, tint, blur or glass: a full SDP offer needs every module readable at arm's length.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every live number (speed, percent, bytes, time left, file counts) uses tabular figures (`"tnum", "ss01"`), so values update without jitter.

rules.name: The Tracking Scales With Size Rule
rules.body: Tracking tightens with size: -0.012em on rows, -0.02em on titles, -0.032em on headlines, -0.04 to -0.05em on display and speed.

rules.name: The Glass Not Border Rule
rules.body: Containers are defined by an inset white edge and blur, never by a solid stroke. The only real borders are the scanner corner brackets and the dashed drop zone.

rules.name: The Lit From Above Rule
rules.body: Every fill gets a 1px inset top highlight and a top-to-bottom gradient, lighter at the top.

dos: Do take the red from the native token (#D8322A) and keep web and app on one red.
Do build every container from the glass recipe (fill, inset edge, blur, soft drop) and give it a solid `graphite-surface-2` fallback under `prefers-reduced-transparency`.
Do use full pills for every control and 20-28px radii for containers.
Do set every live number in tabular figures.
Do keep the QR on a flat `qr-paper` plate with no centre mark.
Do pair every warning colour with a word and an icon.
donts: Don't add a second accent hue; green and apricot are status only.
Don't use red for decoration that does not mean "act" or "data moving".
Don't draw solid borders on containers; use the inset glass edge.
Don't put the QR on glass, tint it, or blur it.
Don't pull lime or other values from the PC app's "Quiet Signal" world into /p2p/.
